power: Write to bl_power when backlight reaches or leaves 0. Make InternalBacklight write FB_BLANK_UNBLANK to bl_power just before setting the internal backlight brightness to a nonzero value, and FB_BLANK_POWERDOWN to bl_power just before setting the brightness to 0. This is needed for hardware that interprets a brightness level of 0 as meaning "dim" rather than "off". CHROMIUM: ASoC: rt5677: Use Clock_system5 for hotwording This patch switches from Clock_system2 to Clock_system5 on the left Mono ADC filter for the 16KHz hotword capture stream. Using Clock_system2 for hotwording may interfere with normal playback since the codec driver uses it for AIF2. Clock_system5 is not used anywhere else in the codec driver. The pre_div of Clock_system5 is calculated based on MCLK input now instead of using a fixed value, in case MCLK changes at runtime. BUG=b:25712345 TEST=build chromeos-3.18 for smaug Change-Id: I148e8f3232641761999eba6e22f4d00e8fdef57e Signed-off-by: Ben Zhang <benzh@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/313658 Reviewed-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org>

Bump the timeout for unit tests by 20 minutes. This time limit of 70 minutes was set originally when the tests took 10 minutes to run. We have a lot more tests now and so they run slower, and therefore the timeout needs to be bumped. Unit tests usually take 30 minutes or so to run, but they can take twice as long if the machine is under heavy load. Give the builder lots of time to run tests.
